settings.label: Name
settings.notice: Profiles show this name, e.g. "Supplier SFTP".

settings.label: Port
settings.notice: Empty = 22 for SFTP, 21 for FTP.

settings.label: Password
settings.notice: Stored encrypted, never shown again.

settings.label: Private key
settings.notice: OpenSSH or PEM private key for key login. Stored encrypted, never shown again.

settings.label: Region
settings.notice: The AWS region of the bucket. S3-compatible services: the region they ask for, often us-east-1 or auto.

settings.label: Endpoint
settings.notice: Empty for Amazon S3. Cloudflare R2, Wasabi, MinIO, Garage and others: the address of the service.

settings.label: Path-style addresses
settings.notice: endpoint/bucket/file instead of bucket.endpoint/file. Most self-hosted services need it.

settings.label: Secret key
settings.notice: Stored encrypted, never shown again.

settings.label: Log in as
settings.notice: A service account suits servers (share the folders with its e-mail address); a Google account sees what that person sees.

settings.label: Service account key
settings.notice: The JSON key file of the service account (Google Cloud console › IAM › Service accounts › Keys). Stored encrypted, never shown again.

item.name: noticeByType
item.item: Of an OAuth client of the type "Web application" in your Google Cloud project, with the Google Drive API switched on.
The app key of your Dropbox app (dropbox.com/developers/apps), with the permissions files.content.read and files.content.write.
The application (client) ID of your app registration in Microsoft Entra ID (entra.microsoft.com), a "Web" platform with the redirect URI below.

settings.label: Client secret
settings.notice: Stored encrypted, never shown again.

settings.label: Directory (tenant)
settings.notice: Your organisation's directory (tenant) ID or domain; empty = common (any account the app allows).

settings.label: SharePoint site
settings.notice: Empty = the signed-in user's OneDrive; a site address = its document library.

settings.label: Redirect URI
settings.notice: Add this address as redirect URI of your OAuth client or app.

settings.label: Base address
settings.notice: Profiles add their own path to it, e.g. /products.

settings.label: Header value
settings.notice: The whole value, e.g. "Bearer abc123" or the API key. Stored encrypted, never shown again.

settings.label: Password
settings.notice: Stored encrypted, never shown again.

settings.label: Client secret
settings.notice: Stored encrypted, never shown again.

settings.label: Scope
settings.notice: Optional, as the API asks for it.

settings.label: Time limit (seconds)
settings.notice: How long to wait for the server, 5 to 300 seconds. Empty = 30.
